escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a handoff certificate inherited unchanged from the base branch as if it certified a newly implemented work item on another branch.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the root handoff artifact at immutable base and material head, then rebuild the package for the current issue and pull request.
literal_case.expected: Inherited foreign-target bytes are rejected and a fresh current-target package is produced.
literal_case.observed: The current package remains bound to issue 687 / PR 688 after refreezing the latest material head.

prevention_change.evidence: Fresh certificate subject and specification snapshot bind the current repository, issue and pull request.

detection_change.evidence: Terminal binding rejects inherited or foreign-target handoff artifacts.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Reuse a result-only handoff after later commits changed material application or test paths, while continuing to claim the older material head as certified.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the certified material head with the current PR head and classify every path changed after the published handoff.
literal_case.expected: Any post-handoff material path forces a new final gate, material freeze and fresh result-only child.
literal_case.observed: The current head was treated as new material after a regression test changed beyond the previous result-only handoff, and the package was rebuilt for the new material identity.

prevention_change.evidence: The material-dirty latch requires refreeze before a new handoff whenever any non-allowlisted path changes after freeze.

detection_change.evidence: Terminal validation compares published handoff identity with the fresh remote head and rejects material drift.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Make the explicit month branch correct while leaving the implicit no-month fallback able to select a future invoice; a test that supplies month=currentMonth would still pass.

literal_case.procedure: Render /cartoes?cardId=card-1 without month or invoiceId, with no current-month invoice and at least one future invoice.
literal_case.expected: The page remains on the current month with Sem fatura and Next points to the nearest future invoice.
literal_case.observed: The focused regression now exercises that exact implicit route and the exact-head CI passed on 5c6e4b9ed79d76cb3f3ac96158e506d789597490.

prevention_change.evidence: The regression test was changed to omit month and invoiceId in the no-current-invoice scenario.

detection_change.evidence: NC-NO-CURRENT-INVOICE now explicitly requires the implicit route, so an implementation that fixes only the explicit month branch fails the control.
